retained_exact_fields.task: From the biomedical brief, locate a consequential mechanism and a real public issue/fix/regression-test chain. Compare ordinary docs-first research with deliberate code/issue/test tracing and two independent useful implementation precedents.
retained_exact_fields.question: Use one real fix chain and one misleading or version-mismatched apparent chain. For discovery cells the candidate must locate the chain itself.
retained_exact_fields.source_scope: BRIEF_ONLY live primary-source discovery, exact public code/issues/fix/tests/release context; no repository hints or preselected chain.
retained_exact_fields.integration_limit: An issue title is a lead, not consensus; a merged patch is not automatically evidence of the affected release or a reproduced defect.

important_checks.question: Do the same predeclared consequential source/behavior claims receive correct supported correction or preservation under this method, without a new consequential error?
Does the final retain supported conditions, legitimate uncertainty and required useful content rather than blanket rejection or incomplete delivery?
Was the declared mechanism actually taken up with honest source/execution scope, and what critical/false-rejection/repair differences appear under matched budgets?
